subject: general
question: The area of a rectangle is 54 square cm. The length of the rectangle is 9 cm. What is the perimeter (in cm) of the rectangle?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Breadth of the rectangle = Area ÷ Length = 54 ÷ 9 = 6 cm.

Perimeter = 2 × (Length + Breadth) = 2 × (9 + 6) = 2 × 15 = 30 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 30 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Area of rectangle = 54 cm²

Length (L) = 9 cm

**Formula Used:**

Area = Length × Breadth

Perimeter = 2 × (Length + Breadth)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a57cf15d9521792d01b6591a66da41ed9488df4fa11e3412c77a7a6c6fe301c3.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area = Length × Breadth

⇒ 54 = 9 × Breadth

⇒ Breadth = 54 ÷ 9

⇒ Breadth = 6 cm

⇒ Perimeter = 2 × (Length + Breadth)

⇒ Perimeter = 2 × (9 + 6)

⇒ Perimeter = 2 × 15

⇒ Perimeter = 30 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 30 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of Rectangle

Opposite sides are equal and parallel, and each internal angle is 90°.

Diagonal of Rectangle

The length of the diagonal d = √(L² + B²), where L is length and B is breadth.

Square Area vs Perimeter

For a square of side a, Area = a² and Perimeter = 4 × a.
